notes:
CRM notes (fragments + bullets) - inbound SMB lead, early discovery. Key pain: latency spikes at peak hours after recent marketing blast. Customer context: support SaaS with multi-tenant chat help widget; typical session = 2-6 messages, average input length 120-220 tokens, sometimes long transcripts pasted (1k+ tokens)

Observed behavior / customer reported:
- Baseline: avg latency ~220-350ms in us-east-1 for small requests; p95 ~700ms; p99 spikes to 2.5-4s during peak bursts (~20 concurrent users per instance).
- They run from a single web region (us-east-1) and haven't tried other regions. "Feels fine most of the day, but spikes when marketing sends emails" - CSM paraphrase.

Customer goals and constraints:
- Low-cost / self-serve hosted API; wants predictable sub-500ms for interactive chat for most users.
- Cost sensitive: wants to keep monthly API spend under $2k while they validate product-market-fit.
- Security: SSO/SAML and audit logs required later; currently evaluating SAML with IdP config pending.
- No desire for private/on-prem at this stage; public cloud only.

SE findings / recommendations given during call (Ravi):
- Region: recommend testing us-west-2 and us-east-2 for west/coastal users; round-trip to us-east-1 is fine for NA but p99 improved ~20-30% when routing to nearest region. Suggest per-route region override based on Geo-IP.
- Timeouts: set client-side connect+read timeout to 15-20s for generation endpoints; implement short-circuit UI timeouts at 3.5s for first response then stream remainder.
- Streaming: enable streaming responses in the widget to improve perceived latency; send short initial prompts to get early tokens out.
- Prompt guidance: avoid pasting full transcript on every request. Use summarization step server-side: send last 2 messages + 1-line summary of earlier history to keep prompt tokens under ~600 tokens for chat flows.
- Batching & concurrency: throttle background embedding/rerank jobs; keep concurrent requests per token-account low (<= 8) to avoid queuing. Use exponential backoff on 429s.
- Model choice: recommend switching to a smaller latency-optimized model variant for interactive UI (e.g., rdx-small-llm or quantized variant) and reserve larger models for async tasks (summarization, quality checks).
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts; cache recent question/answer pairs where appropriate.
- Fallbacks: configure automatic fallback to next compatible model in same region when capacity is constrained; surface graceful degradation to front-end (show "processing..." spinner + partial answer).
